title: Penalties on NBFCs for KYC and Governance Violations
description: <cite index="19-1,19-2">RBI imposed a penalty of ₹6.20 lakh on Avail Financial Services Limited for violating governance and credit/investment concentration norms</cite>. <cite index="19-3,19-4">The RBI imposed monetary penalties on six NBFCs for violating various regulatory rules based on statutory inspections conducted as of March 31, 2025</cite>. <cite index="19-10,19-11,19-12">Muthoot Finance Limited was fined ₹5.80 lakh for KYC violations, including failure to regularly review customer risk categorization and implement suspicious transaction monitoring systems</cite>.
